role: Interface for the resource lookup layer: domains, one resource, or all resources for a location across packs (FallbackResourceManager and SimpleReloadableResourceManager implement it).
notes: Every texture, sound and lang file the game loads goes through this interface on the Java side; the native engine reads pre-converted files by path instead. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: Resource lookup interface; native reads pre-converted files by path.
